_note: Every incident, zone, safe zone, team and update here is fictional. Zones are illustrative, not a measured flood footprint. Place names and road geometry are real (routes: OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL, via the OSRM foot profile); a route is a walking path on the road network and does not know which roads are flooded. GeoJSON rings and routes are [lng, lat].

severe: Go to the highest floor you can reach now. Do not wait.
Stay out of the water. Moving water 15 cm deep can knock you over.
Switch off electricity at the mains if you can reach it safely.
If you cannot leave, call 999 or send a rescue request.
high: Leave for the nearest safe zone now if the way is clear.
Take only your phone, ID, medicine and water.
If water blocks the way, go upstairs and request help.
moderate: Get ready to leave. Charge your phone and pack ID and medicine.
Move vehicles and valuables to higher ground if it is safe.
Check on neighbours who may need help.
Leave for a safe zone if the water rises.

alerts.title: Flash flood at Sunway–Monash
alerts.text: Jalan Lagoon Selatan is under water between Monash University and South Quay. Do not drive through.

alerts.title: Seksyen 13 roads impassable
alerts.text: Flood water across Seksyen 13. Roads near the stadium are closed.

alerts.title: Flash flood on Jalan USJ 4
alerts.text: Water rose quickly after heavy rain. Underpasses are closed.

alerts.title: Relief point open at Sunway University
alerts.text: The North Building is open for anyone leaving the flood area. Water and charging points are available.

alerts.title: River rising at Bukit Raja
alerts.text: River gauge KL-11 shows the level rising fast. Residents nearby should get ready to leave.

alerts.title: BRT Sunway line suspended
alerts.text: BRT services between SunU-Monash and South Quay are suspended until the water recedes.

alerts.title: Water receding along USJ 9
alerts.text: Levels are dropping. Roads stay closed until they are checked.

alerts.title: Second boat unit sent to Monash
alerts.text: A second boat unit is on its way to the Monash University side of the flood.
